sql:
select
  status,
  count(*) as total_requests,
  count(completed_at) as completed_count,
  count(*) - count(completed_at) as not_completed_count,
  min(received_at) as oldest_received_at,
  max(received_at) as newest_received_at,
  avg(case when completed_at is null then date(DATE '2026-01-05') - date(received_at) end) as avg_age_days_not_completed
from data_subject_requests
group by status
order by total_requests desc, status asc
note: One row per data_subject_requests.status across full history, platform-wide (no tenant filter, as requested). avg_age_days_not_completed is null when every row of that status already has completed_at set.
